body:
| Extension | Renderer | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `.md` | MDX pipeline | GFM, tables, task lists |
| `.mdx` | MDX pipeline | JSX components (sandboxed for non-local sources) |
| `.json`, `.jsonc` | Tree viewer + raw tab | Virtualized for large files |
| `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.js`, `.jsx` | Shiki code viewer | Fold, copy, line links |
| `.yaml`, `.yml`, `.toml` | Shiki code viewer | |
| `.css`, `.scss`, `.html` | Shiki code viewer | |
| `.csv`, `.tsv` | Table viewer | Sticky header, filter, sort |
| `.log`, `.txt` | Monospace viewer | Grep / highlight box |
| `.diff`, `.patch` | Shiki diff grammar | |
| `.svg`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.webp` | Image viewer | Zoom, pan |
| (unknown) | Fallback: Shiki auto-detect or plain text | |

v0.2+: `.ipynb`, `.sqlite`, `.parquet` (sample), `.xml`, `.geojson` map view.
